verses.en: O sing unto the LORD a new song: sing unto the LORD, all the earth.
verses.sm: Atua Ia outou pepese atu i le ALII i le pese fou; le lalolagi uma e,

verses.en: Sing unto the LORD, bless his name; shew forth his salvation from day to day.
verses.sm: ia outou pepese atu i le ALII. Ia outou pepese atu i le ALII, ia outou faafetaia lona suafa;

verses.en: Declare his glory among the heathen, his wonders among all people.
verses.sm: ia outou tala‘i atu lana faaolataga i lea aso ma lea aso.

verses.en: For the LORD is great, and greatly to be praised: he is to be feared above all gods.
verses.sm: la outou tautau atu lona mamalu i nuu ese, ma ona vavega i nuu uma lava. Auā e silisili le ALII,

verses.en: For all the gods of the nations are idols: but the LORD made the heavens.
verses.sm: e tusa foi ona matuā viia o ia; e sili ona matautia o ia i atua uma. Auā o atua uma o nuu o tupua lava ia;

verses.en: Honour and majesty are before him: strength and beauty are in his sanctuary.
verses.sm: a ole ALII, na ia faia le lagi. O loo i ona luma le viiga ma le matagofie ;

verses.en: Give unto the LORD, O ye kindreds of the people, give unto the LORD glory and strength.
verses.sm: o loo i lona malumalu le malosi ma le mamalu. Outou o itu aiga o le nuu, ia outou avatua i le ALII,

verses.en: Give unto the LORD the glory due unto his name: bring an offering, and come into his courts.
verses.sm: ia outou avatua i le ALTI le viiga ma le malosi. Ia outou avatua i le ALII le viiga o lona suafa;

verses.en: O worship the LORD in the beauty of holiness: fear before him, all the earth.
verses.sm: ia outou avatu taulaga, ma outou o atu i ona lotoā. Ia outou ifo atu i le ALII i le malumalu e matagofie;

verses.en: Say among the heathen that the LORD reigneth: the world also shall be established that it shall not be moved: he shall judge the people righteously.
verses.sm: ia ontou gatete i ona luma le lalolagi uma. Ia outou fai atu i nuu ese, Ua fai le ALII ma tupu; e faatumauina ai le lalolagi neʻi faagaeetia; na te faamasinotonuina le nuu.

verses.en: Let the heavens rejoice, and let the earth be glad; let the sea roar, and the fulness thereof.
verses.sm: Ia fiafia le lagi, ia olioli foi le lalolagi; ia taalili mai le sami ma mea ua tumu ai;

verses.en: Let the field be joyful, and all that is therein: then shall all the trees of the wood rejoice
verses.sm: ia fiafia lava le laueleele ma mea uma o i ai; ona alalaga fiafia ai lea o laau uma o i le vao matua,

verses.en: Before the LORD: for he cometh, for he cometh to judge the earth: he shall judge the world with righteousness, and the people with his truth.
verses.sm: i luma o le ALII; aua o loo afio mai, auā o loo afio mai e faamasino le lalolagi; na te faamasinoina le atu laulau i le amiotonu, atoa ma nuu i lona faamaoni.
